comment: Which instruction ending each Korean level uses, and how the player climbs the ladder. 'ending' and 'forcedEnding' are generator names from grammar.json (see quest/grammar/Endings); 'grammar' is the construction a step at that level exercises. 'forcedEnding' is used only where the sentence states a forced conclusion, otherwise 'ending' applies. 'connectives' marks the levels whose tasks may add a connective where the goal type supports it. 'gateSteps' is how many quest steps at a level the player must have met before the next level opens. 'aliases' map ids that goal types emit to the construction in grammar.json that teaches them; an id with no entry in grammar.json and no alias is ignored.
